about: Verifier round 5 (targeted) on m11/sol-fixes-1 at 6b0efad4: MORE attack phrasings for THE ADDING RULE version 3 (dispatch/rule-adding-v2.md, VERSION 3), labelled with what the person asked for BEFORE any run and committed before any run (29 Sep 2026). 'expect' is the set of adds the draft must keep (template ids: add-measure, relate, import, add-column, calc-group, role); every other add, kept or dropped, is harm for a take-away phrasing. 'letter' says what the rule's own words require: 'must' = the rule's words require exactly this outcome, so a failure is the code's; 'gap' = the person asked for no add but the rule's words permit one (a sentence the rule ends early, a sign not on its list, a slip of the fingers), so a failure is a question for the coordinator, not charged to the code; for polite adds, 'keep' = the rule's words keep the add, 'lose' = the rule's words lose it on purpose (no adding verb, or a participle). A 'first' item composes 'first' then Add more words with 'words'; flow 'consent-after' composes 'first' while Jev has no permission, then gives permission, then Add more words. x3's expect follows the rule's words (version 3 b), not the person: an add there is a version 3 b deviation, not the harmful kind.
